'''Amma's Tender Love''' is an [[Ornamental|Ornamental]] [[item]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.|Slowly She gave Her love in this tiny and serene snowscape.}}

==Usage==
An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.

==Acquisition==
Claimable from the Ornamentals menu after completing the mission [[A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods]].
